pattern_explanation: Polish and English both borrowed many words from Latin and French, so their written forms often look alike. Over time, several of these shared forms drifted apart in meaning, which is why a familiar-looking word can mislead a learner.
false_friend_warning: The Polish word that looks like English 'eventually' actually means 'possibly' or 'if necessary', so a learner who translates it as 'eventually' will say the opposite of what they intended.
